name: Aohitsugi Nemu
source: She is a member of the political party Party of Words and has held the post of Deputy Director of the Administrative Inspection Bureau at a young age. She is Samatoki's younger sister and used to live with her brother. [spoiler]She was mind-hacked by Ramuda clone and joined the Party of Words, but her strong will allowed her to regain her sanity. While stating that she does not agree with some aspects of the policies and system, she continues to work in the Party of Words in order to realize a world without conflict.[/spoiler]
